recipe.visualDefinition: A layered collage composition featuring a painterly portrait of a male musician with an acoustic guitar, set against a dark blue textured background. The portrait is partially overlaid by a curled sheet of music paper on the left, which contains a tracklist. The entire scene is framed by a wide teal border with technical metadata at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The curled sheet music acts as a foreground element overlapping the portrait.
The red plaid shirt of the subject creates a high-contrast focal point against the blue background.
The teal outer frame provides a structured container for the organic, painterly central image.
coreInvariants: Curled paper texture on the left third
Impasto-style oil painting for the subject
High-contrast red and blue color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The musician is positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, rendered from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The musician's face and the red plaid shirt serve as the primary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold red title on the left, follows the curve of the paper down the tracklist, and then moves right to the portrait and guitar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark blue area behind the musician's head provides breathing room for the secondary title.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light Blue (secondary title) and Cream (sheet music)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red and teal, contrasted with deep values in the blue background.

composition.position: Top left of the sheet music
composition.rotation: Slightly angled to match paper curl

composition.position: Top right of the portrait area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same condensed sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, mid-century display look.
Provides the clean, modern-retro condensed feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a painterly oil portrait of a man in a red plaid shirt holding an acoustic guitar, set against a dark blue textured background. Frame this with a wide teal border. On the left, add a large sheet of cream-colored paper with a curled right edge, featuring faint musical notation.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed red uppercase text at the top of the cream paper. Add a list of song titles in a smaller, black condensed font below it. In the top right blue area, add the artist's name in a medium-sized, light blue condensed font.

verificationChecks: Is the teal border present and uniform?
Does the red shirt contrast sharply with the blue background?
Is the sheet music paper visibly curled at the edge?
Are all fonts condensed and uppercase?

avoid: Clean vector lines in the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text on the curled paper follows the perspective of the curl.
Verify the impasto brushstrokes are visible in the portrait.
Check that the teal border is not cropped.
Confirm the hierarchy between the red title and the blue name.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Oil Portrait] with [Collage Element: Curled Paper] framed by [Solid Color Border] using [Condensed Sans-Serif Typography].
